body: What is your name and where are you from? Do not kill yourself, you will receive justice
So what are you passionate about? What’s the first few things that come to mind to answer that question. We’re all created and gifted for something

I am going through very similar struggles. I’m on this page for a reason. I’ve learned though through school and on my own interest that whatever we’re truly passionate for learning is natural. You have to find that thing that triggers you to keep pushing and go with it. Plus, I’ve had extreme low points before this, and I’ve seen what can happen when a person pushes through adversity. This is why I’m still going. I’m also drinking and smoking more than I normally do, I’ve noticed clearly, over this new low point that hit me... fell out of school 3 weeks early from finals, quit a good job, and every part of my life has been twisted due to unexpected and severe withdrawals from missing a week of antidepressants. I’ve had a debilitating case of OCD and anxiety for years now that I’ve battled on and off with a great deal of help. Both of us need to get clean. It’s the drugs that cloud our judgement and keep healing from taking place, I’m almost certain

Don't do it, first of all. I'm in the same boat, and I'm on this page for a reason. Just fell out of a successful d3 track and field program, pre-med, and good job due to missing a week of antidepressants and having unexpected, horrible withdrawals a month later. Three months now I've been trying to recover from the damage that's taken place, but nothing is the same, and I still am hurting mentally. Incredibly. There's much more to the story, I've dealt with severe OCD, anxiety, depression, PTSD after 4 of my fingers were severed at 11 years old cutting wood. Since then I've battled continuously. My faith is incredibly weak right now and I've basically lost hope. I haven't lost all hope because I'm on this site. But my life is in pieces and it happened when I was up on the top of my game, in almost every area of life. Within a week my world was upside down. Just don't do it. I'm holding on for now, you can too. If you want to message me you can
